data: What is the accuracy of the line with yellow markers when alpha is 0.6?

The line with yellow markers represents the accuracy of the Radical-enhanced model. The question asks for the accuracy of this line when alpha is 0.6. From the figure, we can see that at alpha = 0.6, the yellow line (Radical-enhanced model) has an accuracy value of approximately 0.4. Therefore, the accuracy of the line with yellow markers when alpha is 0.6 is around 0.4.
